(That's right, don't just stand there dazed! Don't look away!
Look at me! Look at me!!)

After all, Ticket cut in ahead of you the other day.
...So say it now. You know... that thing.

Ah, you mean the one Narita Taishin is running in?
I heard it's to assess her potential once more, but...
...Ghh, huh?

Doryaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!
FULL! POWER! SPAAAAAARK!!
Seeing Narita Taishin looking down with a grim expression, I couldn't help but call out to her.
They seem quite close, so she's probably the one who best understands the strength of Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket that was mentioned earlier.

It was even sharper than what I saw on video...
A veritable blade forged through her unwavering will and persistent effort.

Ooh... Biwa Hayahide is making great time.
She's taken a great spot right behind the front pack.

...Stop that.
Having you shout right after a race is seriously exhausting.

...Oh? Narita Taishin is that far back...?
Don't tell me she botched her start?
Even so—the starting gates open.
It turned into a magnificent race that more than proved the boundless potential of the Umamusume named Narita Taishin...
Huh? ...Who are you to act so high and mighty?
"No, because that's how you can win!"
—! No, on the outside...!!
Ticket—

Narita Taishin...!?
Wh-What an incredible late charge!?
Honestly, I think the outcome is obvious. ...More than that, I just hope that girl doesn't push herself too hard and end up injured again.
...Shut up.

Biwa Hayahide with her meticulous logic, Winning Ticket with her explosive bursts of speed.
And all the other entrants are talented runners who have been steadily improving their skills...
Ah...

Even so... I still couldn't catch you!!
The fire inside me is still blazing hot...!!

(...Damn it, don't panic. The front's getting closed off more and more...
It looks like a solid wall...)
—Ghh...
However, the consensus among the spectators was—
"—Save your stamina carefully in the early stages."
"When it comes to the final burst, you won't lose to anyone!!"

Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket!
Is this final stretch going to be a duel between the top two after all...!?
(But—)
Maybe because Winning Ticket is racing against so many familiar faces, she looks in great shape today! I'm really looking forward to the final stretch.

—Come to think of it, did you hear?
About the mock race this weekend.
(I am—the racing Umamusume, Narita Taishin...!)
Hayahide...
That's... But if a powerhouse like Hayahide pulls away that far and manages to break away...!
"When it comes to the final burst, you won't lose to anyone!!"

So!! Def-i-nite-ly, absolutelyyyyyyy!!
Let's race with everything we've got again, Taishin!!!!
Aaaaaaaahhh!!

...It seems I still have much to learn.
To misjudge an Umamusume of your caliber—
Thanks to Winning Ticket shouting about it all across the academy day after day, word about the mock race had spread far and wide.
"No, because that's how you can win!"
Narita Taishin's expression remained tense. But in my mind, her brilliant late charge from the recording was still vividly burned into memory—
I wasn't sure if I had conveyed everything fully.
(—CLANG!!)
...Good grief.
Are you telling me to just roll over and lose without trying because it looks unsightly...!?

Because, because, because! —I was giving it everything I had!
Today too, just like always, I was screaming 'I'm gonna wiiin!'

I simply cannot stand by and let such a capable rival be lost to us here.
...To put it plainly, that is all.

Here it comes, the fourth corner...!
Ah, Winning Ticket is making her move!!
—Haaaaah!!
"—...You don't need to get tangled up fighting for position."
Heh, just as predicted, Winning Ticket...!

...Seriously, what is with you...
I don't get it at all, you're way too intense...

That's not it!! Idiot, I'm gonna kick you!
That's not what I mean...!!
...Yeah. ...Looking forward to working with you.
...So embarrassing.
...It seems the meaning behind our entry in this race got through to you.

......Haha.
You're way too loud, so no way, dummy.
—It was after that when Narita Taishin walked over to me with hesitant footsteps.
Haa... haa... haa...

...Aaaaaaagh!!
I'm soooooo fruuuustraaaated!!

—Winning the breathtakingly close contest was Narita Taishin.
Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket crossed the finish line right behind her.
